description: Sells all or part of an open wager (position) for the user. It moves the user's balance and cannot be undone, so only run it after the user has confirmed a simulation for the same wager and shares (get_bet_simulation with side ask, or get_partial_sell_amount). Pass the wager id; omit `shares` to sell the whole position. On order-book events, which is every current market, the sale is placed as a sell order on the wager's market: without `price` it sells immediately at the best bids, with `price` it is a limit order that may rest on the book. The result then contains the created `order`.

id.description: Wager id, as returned by get_user_bets (field `id`). This is not a market id or an event id.

price.description: Order-book events only: minimum price per share to accept, in whole cents between 0.01 and 0.99. Omit to sell immediately at the best available bids.

shares.description: Number of shares to sell. Omit to sell the entire position. Must not exceed the shares held; selling all of them is the same as omitting it.

name: sell_bet
title: Sell a bet
